name: Spiced Chicken Sandwich with Herby Potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Cut the potatoes into bite-sized pieces, toss on a baking tray with half the oil, the oregano, salt and pepper and roast for 25 minutes until golden and crisp.
Season the chicken breasts with the chilli flakes, salt and pepper. Mix the sliced spring onion with the mayonnaise, chopped garlic, vinegar and a pinch of salt to make a garlic mayo.
Heat the rest of the oil in a lidded pan and fry the chicken for 3 minutes on each side until golden, add a splash of water, cover and cook for 10 to 12 minutes until cooked through with no pink.
Toast the bread on a tray in the oven for 5 minutes until hot, and shred the lettuce.
Slice the chicken, fill the toast with the chicken, garlic mayo and lettuce, and serve with the herby potatoes and the rest of the lettuce.
